items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 58:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the bosom of Aba and Ima? When ZON ascend to the aspect of MAN to the palace of Aba and Ima, and are included in the screen of the NHY of Aba and Ima, they are discerned as having ascended to the bosom of Aba and Ima, for the NHY are called the bosom. (Item 137).
